text: In Cubical Agda (--cubical), a path p : a ≡ b is literally:
choices: an element of the inductive identity type
a function (i : I) → A with p i0 ≡ a and p i1 ≡ b (definitionally)
explanation: Paths in Cubical Agda are functions from the interval I. p i0 and p i1 reduce definitionally to their endpoints.
